A realistic workout plan for your equipment and space

Pick your goal, level, schedule, equipment and free space to train — TrainUp builds an achievable program, guides you through every workout with exercise images, and adjusts upcoming sessions to how you feel.
What the plan takes into account
Floor space, ceiling height and surface
The days and minutes you can spare
Goal, level, schedule, equipment and space — minimal typing, maximum visual choice.
The planner rules out exercises you lack the equipment, space or time for, and builds a 4-week plan.
Exercise images, rest timer, set check-offs and effort rating — upcoming workouts adapt conservatively.
“I work out at home” is not the whole story. A narrow hallway or a low ceiling changes which exercises suit you. TrainUp never treats unknown space as suitable for exercises that need it.
AI only if you want it
The core plan is built without AI. If AI is connected, it can explain the program or suggest changes, but every proposal goes through the same equipment, space and time validator.
TrainUp does not diagnose and does not replace a doctor’s advice. If you feel pain, stop: the app will not increase the load automatically.
